title: Characterization of the polynomial hierarchy
statement: For every language $L$ over the binary alphabet, $L$ belongs to the polynomial hierarchy if and only if there is a natural number $i$ such that $L\in\Sigma_i^P$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the binary alphabet
